forensic_summary: The Trigger: During 'Capaldi FOH' environmental chamber testing, the embedded Kontron 986LCD-M motherboard hit 75°C, triggering a hard 'System Shutdowned' failure. Management simultaneously issued a 'No Extrusion' mandate to meet the <$15k COGS target. The Intervention: Executed a 'Design of Experiments' thermal matrix testing chassis heights (3U vs 4U) and fan voltages. Engineered the '4U Rake Back I-Beam' (P/N 9420-58317-00), a complex folded steel spine to replace expensive aluminum extrusions, and implemented custom air ducting (P/N 9420-58856-00). The Result: Validated a 4U chassis architecture with a 3-fan array running at 12V, stabilizing internal temperature rise to 22.6°C and eliminating the shutdown risk while securing touring-grade rigidity without extrusions.
